description: This file defines the DashboardFragment class, which is a UI component displaying dashboard statistics and recent trade data in an Android app. It sets up view bindings, observes ViewModel data, and handles navigation to a trade detail screen.

classes.name: DashboardFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass managing the dashboard UI, displaying summary statistics and recent trades, with data binding and user interaction handling.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes view components, sets up RecyclerView, and observes ViewModel LiveData to update UI.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Reloads dashboard data when the fragment becomes visible.
